Thanks Emily — appreciate the quick context and the attachments.

Short answers up front: yes, we have an academic credits program for research labs and the usual range is $2kto15k depending on scope. We typically approve $1kto5k for first-time lab grants and escalate for multi-year programs. To move this forward I need two things from you: 1) confirmation that the signup account email (the one you used on the PLG flow) is the lab account you want credited, and 2) a brief line about intended use (you provided the summary, which helps).

Im looping in Lauren from Sales Ops and Neha from Customer Success to complete the approval and issuance steps (they handle the voucher/promo creation and redemption instructions). Lauren/Neha  can you advise next steps and whether $5k is within standard first-time approval? If you need additional docs, please flag.

Best,

Hi Dr. Foster,

Welcome — Im Neha from Customer Success. Per the approval from Sales Ops, weve issued a one-time $5,000 academic credit for research-pubpolicy@fairfield.edu. Below are the steps to redeem and see the credit on your account:

1) Sign in to your Redwood Console at https://console.redwood.com and go to Billing > Credits.
2) Click "Redeem voucher" and paste the voucher code: FAIR-ACAD-5000
3) Credits will appear immediately on your billing page under "Promotional Credits." You can monitor usage per token and per-route in the Console.

Required paperwork: we ask for a signed usage attestation for audit purposes (one-page DocuSign). Please sign here: https://www.docusign.com/sign/FAIR-ACAD-USE-AGREEMENT

Notes: the voucher expires in 180 days and is limited to the account email provided. If the lab wants to split credits across sub-accounts, let me know and we can set that up from our side.

Attachments: credits_approval_form.pdf (for your records)

If you run into any issues redeeming, reply to this thread and Ill jump on a short call to walk through it.
